in_marathi.name: Parbat
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Mountain peak, abode of gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Parbat हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Parbat is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'parvata' meaning mountain peak or hill. In Hindu mythology, Parvati is the consort of Lord Shiva and is regarded as the goddess of love, fertility, and beauty. The name is associated with the divine and is believed to bestow grace, prosperity, and spiritual growth upon the bearer.
